component.name: TYTcps
component.summary: Program TYT MD-UV390 Plus radios, AES privacy keys included

description.p: A programmer for the TYT MD-UV390 and MD-UV390 Plus DMR radios: read and write codeplugs with the stock CPS's pages, and write the Plus's AES privacy keys, with every read checked twice and every write verified.
The radio needs a USB permission rule on the computer before TYTcps can reach it; the install instructions give the one command.
